svg.title: iOS · Settings · Libraries · New Library on PicPlace (alert with a name) · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors the Libraries card's New Library on PicPlace… (App/SettingsView.swift, namingNewLibrary → createLibraryOnPicPlace; PicPlaceController.createLibraryOnPicPlace) — libraries plan L25, C2c (2026-09-17; verified on the Simulator with the throwaway account: 'Phone Made' created on the server, its folder made, opened). An alert with a text field: title 'New library on PicPlace', prose 'An empty library named on PicPlace; this iPhone opens it and captures land in it.', the field 'Library name', Create (bold) · Cancel. Create PUTs /libraries/{uuid} with a fresh uuid and the name first — a failure (no session, an empty name, the server unreachable) shows in the Libraries alert and nothing is made here — then makes the folder under Libraries/ with that uuid and name as its identity, writes the binding (clean, pending), and switches to it; the first pass has nothing to exchange and the card reads 'Library in step with PicPlace — Nothing to exchange'.

g.text: An empty library named on PicPlace; this
iPhone opens it and captures land in it.
